gaps.name: terminology
gaps.risk: nanoparticles and autonomous robots are conflated
gaps.test: report size, actuation, sensing, computation, trigger, and recovery separately

gaps.name: biological_transport
gaps.risk: static binding does not predict delivery under flow and barriers
gaps.test: human vascular microfluidics plus biodistribution and residence measurements

gaps.name: control_and_energy
gaps.risk: external actuation or molecular triggers may lack penetration, precision, or power
gaps.test: low-Re transport, field exposure, trigger specificity, and energy budget

gaps.name: immune_and_toxicity
gaps.risk: acute animal tolerability hides protein-corona, complement, repeat-dose, and clearance effects
gaps.test: innate/adaptive immune panel, organ histology, repeat dose, and degradation

gaps.name: manufacturing
gaps.risk: batch variation changes size, folding, payload, aggregation, and function
gaps.test: critical quality attributes, release assays, stability, and lot comparability

gaps.name: clinical_translation
gaps.risk: animal efficacy is not linked to a patient benefit-risk threshold
gaps.test: staged animal study with predefined efficacy, rescue, safety, and stop rules
